english.title: Man over 21 years party to / procure gross indecency by men ( one under 16 )
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a man of or over the age of 21,

(A)_[were party to]_
(B)_[procured]_

the commission of an act of gross indecency by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a man under the age of 16, with **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), another man
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13 of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
man 21 or over
party to/procured
an act of gross indecency
by a boy under 16
with another man

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE

(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required for prosecution of indecency between males where at least one is under the age of 16.
(ii) See also offence wording: H2314 and H2317 where the offender is aged 16 to 20 years - maximum two years imprisonment.
(iii) As amended by the Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2000.
(iv) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
